display.label: AWS Elastic IP
display.description: Allocate and manage static IPv4 Elastic IP addresses for Amazon EC2 instances and network interfaces

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique identifier name for the Elastic IP, applied as the 'Name' tag.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core Elastic IP settings including name identifier and VPC domain scope.

fields.label: Elastic IP Name
fields.description: Name applied to the Elastic IP as an identifier and 'Name' tag.

validation.pattern_error: Name must contain only alphanumeric characters, dashes, and underscores.

fields.label: Domain
fields.description: Indicates whether this Elastic IP is for use in a VPC.

options.label: VPC
options.description: Allocate Elastic IP for use in Amazon VPC (standard for AWS accounts).

sections.label: Instance & Network Interface Association
sections.description: Optionally attach the Elastic IP to an Amazon EC2 instance or Elastic Network Interface (ENI).

fields.label: EC2 Instance ID
fields.description: EC2 instance ID to associate with the Elastic IP (e.g., i-0123456789abcdef0). Conflicts with Network Interface ID.

fields.label: Network Interface ID
fields.description: Elastic Network Interface (ENI) ID to associate with (e.g., eni-0123456789abcdef0). Conflicts with Instance ID.

fields.label: Private IP Address
fields.description: User-specified primary or secondary private IP address to associate with the Elastic IP address.

validation.pattern_error: Must be a valid IPv4 address (e.g., 10.0.1.50).

sections.label: IP Address Pool & Routing
sections.description: Configure custom IP pools, BYOIP addresses, and network border advertising locations.

fields.label: Network Border Group
fields.description: Location from which the IP address is advertised. Select an AWS Region or specify a Local Zone.

fields.label: Public IPv4 Pool
fields.description: EC2 IPv4 address pool identifier or 'amazon' for standard Amazon-provided pool.

fields.label: IPAM Pool ID
fields.description: The ID of an IPAM pool which has an Amazon-provided or BYOIP public IPv4 CIDR provisioned to it.

fields.label: Customer-Owned IPv4 Pool
fields.description: ID of a customer-owned address pool for AWS Outposts.

fields.label: BYOIP Address
fields.description: IP address from an EC2 BYOIP pool.

validation.pattern_error: Must be a valid IPv4 address (e.g., 198.51.100.1).

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags for organizational, tracking, and cost allocation purposes.

fields.label: Resource Tags
fields.description: Key-value tags assigned to the Elastic IP.
